title: MCP installation gets a clearer path
summary:
MCP installation got a clearer route, while four community projects joined the showcase.

The MCP server package was renamed to `@pollinations/model-context-protocol`, and its executable was corrected so `npx @pollinations/model-context-protocol` can start the server. The Claude Desktop installer now uses the published package name. A later update declares Node.js 14 as the minimum and adds compatibility code, though the changes do not establish that every dependency works on older Node versions.

The project lists gained a Chinese-language Telegram bot for chat, images, speech, and transcription, plus IMyself AI, which offers image, text, and audio features in Chinese and English.

The showcase added toai.chat for AI chat through terminal curl commands and TeekGenAI for prompt-to-image generation without a login. One keeps you in the terminal; the other barely asks you to leave the prompt box.
